reviewer: Claude (the coding session), from the rendered videos and stills, two angles each; not the owner

push-press.note: armpits fold where the arms lock out overhead (teres major, lats stretched); the drive and press themselves read right

kettlebell-swing.note: a crease at the right shoulder at the top of the swing; hinge, bell path and hands on the handle read right

lateral-raise.note: raise to shoulder height, slight forward lean, dumbbells in the hands; front and rear renders

farmers-carry.note: walking stride with the dumbbells at the sides, arms straight

running-intervals.note: sprint stride, knee drive and arm swing read right

sled-push.note: hands on the posts, body angled into the sled, sled on the floor and moving

rowing-intervals.note: catch, drive and layback read as rowing; seat, handle and chain move with the body; the gracilis still stretches and pulls away from the thigh at the catch (the automated check fails it)

cable-woodchop.note: to be re-checked on the new render (the left coracobrachialis spike was the failure)

medicine-ball-rotational-throw.note: ball held, trunk turns, ball leaves the hands at release; it reappears in the hands when the loop restarts (inherent to a looping throw)

air-bike-sprint.note: seated on the bike, hands on the levers, feet on the pedals; levers and cranks move with the body

dumbbell-curl.note: supinated curl, dumbbells in the hands to the shoulders, elbows at the sides; side and front renders

hammer-curl.note: neutral grip held through the curl

triceps-pushdown.note: straight bar at the cable, elbows at the sides, push to extension; cable runs to the top pulley; side and front renders

cable-chest-fly.note: between two towers, handles from the high pulleys, arms open wide and brought together low in front; cables stay in the hands; front and rear renders
